// compare: the two alternative TS sources of rm-v1-ts's measurement
// (tree-sitter, a light line parser), printing tsgraph.js's JSON so the
// real organizer review can run them through a fake `node` on PATH.
// Both resolve references by name, scoped to the file's own top-level
// names and its relative imports: neither has types.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"

	sitter "github.com/smacker/go-tree-sitter"
	"github.com/smacker/go-tree-sitter/typescript/tsx"
	"github.com/smacker/go-tree-sitter/typescript/typescript"
)

type def struct {
	ID       string `json:"id"`
	Pkg      string `json:"pkg"`
	Kind     string `json:"kind"`
	File     string `json:"file"`
	Start    int    `json:"start"`
	End      int    `json:"end"`
	TestFile bool   `json:"test_file"`
	TestFunc bool   `json:"test_func"`
	TestName string `json:"test_name"`
	name     string
	refs     []string // names referenced in the body
}

type file struct {
	rel     string
	defs    []*def
	imports map[string][2]string // local name -> (target rel, exported name)
}

func own(r string) bool {
	if !(strings.HasSuffix(r, ".ts") || strings.HasSuffix(r, ".tsx")) || strings.HasSuffix(r, ".d.ts") {
		return false
	}
	for _, s := range strings.Split(r, "/") {
		if s == "wailsjs" || s == "node_modules" {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

var importRe = regexp.MustCompile(`(?s)import\s+(type\s+)?(?:(\w+)\s*,?\s*)?(?:\{([^}]*)\})?\s*from\s*["'](\.[^"']*)["']`)

func imports(root, rel, src string) map[string][2]string {
	out := map[string][2]string{}
	for _, m := range importRe.FindAllStringSubmatch(src, -1) {
		target := resolve(root, filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(rel), m[4])))
		if target == "" {
			continue
		}
		if m[2] != "" {
			out[m[2]] = [2]string{target, "default"}
		}
		for _, part := range strings.Split(m[3], ",") {
			part = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(part), "type "))
			if part == "" {
				continue
			}
			name, local := part, part
			if i := strings.Index(part, " as "); i > 0 {
				name, local = strings.TrimSpace(part[:i]), strings.TrimSpace(part[i+4:])
			}
			out[local] = [2]string{target, name}
		}
	}
	return out
}

func resolve(root, p string) string {
	for _, c := range []string{p, p + ".ts", p + ".tsx", p + "/index.ts", p + "/index.tsx"} {
		if fi, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(root, c)); err == nil && !fi.IsDir() {
			return c
		}
	}
	return ""
}

var testCall = regexp.MustCompile(`^(describe|it|test)$`)

// ---- tree-sitter

func tsOutline(rel string, src []byte) []*def {
	lang := typescript.GetLanguage()
	if strings.HasSuffix(rel, ".tsx") {
		lang = tsx.GetLanguage()
	}
	p := sitter.NewParser()
	p.SetLanguage(lang)
	tree, err := p.ParseCtx(context.Background(), nil, src)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	root := tree.RootNode()
	var out []*def
	test := strings.HasSuffix(rel, ".test.ts") || strings.HasSuffix(rel, ".test.tsx")
	prevEnd := -1
	docStart := -1
	for i := 0; i < int(root.NamedChildCount()); i++ {
		st := root.NamedChild(i)
		if st.Type() == "comment" {
			if docStart < 0 || int(st.StartPoint().Row) > prevEnd+1 {
				docStart = int(st.StartPoint().Row)
			}
			prevEnd = int(st.EndPoint().Row)
			continue
		}
		start := int(st.StartPoint().Row)
		if docStart >= 0 && prevEnd == start-1 {
			start = docStart
		}
		docStart, prevEnd = -1, int(st.EndPoint().Row)
		decl := st
		if st.Type() == "export_statement" {
			if d := st.ChildByFieldName("declaration"); d != nil {
				decl = d
			}
		}
		add := func(name, kind string, tf bool, tn string) {
			k := kind
			if test {
				k = "test"
			}
			d := &def{ID: "ts:" + rel + "#" + name, Pkg: "ts:" + filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)), Kind: k, File: rel,
				Start: start + 1, End: int(st.EndPoint().Row) + 1, TestFile: test, TestFunc: tf, TestName: tn, name: name}
			collect(decl, src, d)
			out = append(out, d)
		}
		switch decl.Type() {
		case "function_declaration", "generator_function_declaration", "class_declaration", "abstract_class_declaration",
			"type_alias_declaration", "interface_declaration", "enum_declaration":
			if n := decl.ChildByFieldName("name"); n != nil {
				add(n.Content(src), "function", false, "")
			}
		case "lexical_declaration", "variable_declaration":
			for j := 0; j < int(decl.NamedChildCount()); j++ {
				v := decl.NamedChild(j)
				if v.Type() == "variable_declarator" {
					if n := v.ChildByFieldName("name"); n != nil && n.Type() == "identifier" {
						add(n.Content(src), "const", false, "")
					}
				}
			}
		case "expression_statement":
			if !test {
				continue
			}
			c := decl.NamedChild(0)
			if c == nil || c.Type() != "call_expression" {
				continue
			}
			fn := c.ChildByFieldName("function")
			for fn != nil && fn.Type() == "member_expression" {
				fn = fn.ChildByFieldName("object")
			}
			args := c.ChildByFieldName("arguments")
			if fn == nil || fn.Type() != "identifier" || !testCall.MatchString(fn.Content(src)) || args == nil || args.NamedChildCount() == 0 {
				continue
			}
			a := args.NamedChild(0)
			if a.Type() != "string" && a.Type() != "template_string" {
				continue
			}
			name := strings.Trim(a.Content(src), "\"'`")
			add(name, "test", true, name)
		}
	}
	return out
}

func collect(n *sitter.Node, src []byte, d *def) {
	switch n.Type() {
	case "identifier", "type_identifier", "shorthand_property_identifier":
		d.refs = append(d.refs, n.Content(src))
	}
	for i := 0; i < int(n.NamedChildCount()); i++ {
		collect(n.NamedChild(i), src, d)
	}
}

// ---- light line parser

var (
	declRe  = regexp.MustCompile(`^(?:export\s+)?(?:default\s+)?(?:declare\s+)?(?:async\s+)?(function\*?|class|const|let|var|type|interface|enum)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)`)
	lTestRe = regexp.MustCompile("^(describe|it|test)(?:\\.\\w+)*\\(\\s*[\"'`]([^\"'`]*)[\"'`]")
	identRe = regexp.MustCompile(`[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*`)
	strRe   = regexp.MustCompile("\"(?:[^\"\\\\\n]|\\\\.)*\"|'(?:[^'\\\\\n]|\\\\.)*'|//[^\n]*")
)

func lightOutline(rel string, src []byte) []*def {
	lines := strings.Split(string(src), "\n")
	test := strings.HasSuffix(rel, ".test.ts") || strings.HasSuffix(rel, ".test.tsx")
	type at struct {
		line       int
		name       string
		tf         bool
		isDef      bool
		docStarted int
	}
	var starts []at
	for i, l := range lines {
		if l == "" || !regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z_$@/]`).MatchString(l) {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(l, "/") {
			continue
		}
		a := at{line: i}
		if m := declRe.FindStringSubmatch(l); m != nil {
			a.name, a.isDef = m[2], true
		} else if m := lTestRe.FindStringSubmatch(l); m != nil && test {
			a.name, a.tf, a.isDef = m[2], true, true
		}
		starts = append(starts, a)
	}
	var out []*def
	for k, a := range starts {
		if !a.isDef {
			continue
		}
		end := len(lines) - 1
		if k+1 < len(starts) {
			end = starts[k+1].line - 1
		}
		for end > a.line && (strings.TrimSpace(lines[end]) == "" || strings.HasPrefix(lines[end], "/") || strings.HasPrefix(lines[end], " *")) {
			end--
		}
		start := a.line
		for start > 0 {
			t := lines[start-1]
			if strings.HasPrefix(t, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(t, " *") {
				start--
				continue
			}
			break
		}
		kind := "const"
		if test {
			kind = "test"
		}
		d := &def{ID: "ts:" + rel + "#" + a.name, Pkg: "ts:" + filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)), Kind: kind, File: rel,
			Start: start + 1, End: end + 1, TestFile: test, TestFunc: a.tf, name: a.name}
		if a.tf {
			d.TestName = a.name
		}
		body := strRe.ReplaceAllString(strings.Join(lines[a.line:end+1], "\n"), `""`)
		for _, loc := range identRe.FindAllStringIndex(body, -1) {
			if loc[0] > 0 && body[loc[0]-1] == '.' {
				continue
			}
			rest := strings.TrimLeft(body[loc[1]:], " ")
			if strings.HasPrefix(rest, ":") && !strings.HasPrefix(rest, "::") {
				continue
			}
			d.refs = append(d.refs, body[loc[0]:loc[1]])
		}
		out = append(out, d)
	}
	return out
}

func main() {
	mode, root := os.Args[1], os.Args[2]
	var files []*file
	byRel := map[string]*file{}
	_ = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(p string, e os.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		if e.IsDir() && (e.Name() == "node_modules" || strings.HasPrefix(e.Name(), ".")) {
			return filepath.SkipDir
		}
		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, p)
		rel = filepath.ToSlash(rel)
		if e.IsDir() || !own(rel) {
			return nil
		}
		src, _ := os.ReadFile(p)
		f := &file{rel: rel, imports: imports(root, rel, string(src))}
		if mode == "tree-sitter" {
			f.defs = tsOutline(rel, src)
		} else {
			f.defs = lightOutline(rel, src)
		}
		files = append(files, f)
		byRel[rel] = f
		return nil
	})
	var defs []*def
	uses := map[string][]string{}
	for _, f := range files {
		top := map[string]*def{}
		for _, d := range f.defs {
			top[d.name] = d
		}
		for _, d := range f.defs {
			seen := map[string]bool{}
			for _, r := range d.refs {
				var to *def
				if t := top[r]; t != nil {
					to = t
				} else if imp, ok := f.imports[r]; ok {
					if tf := byRel[imp[0]]; tf != nil {
						for _, x := range tf.defs {
							if x.name == imp[1] {
								to = x
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if to == nil || to == d || seen[to.ID] {
					continue
				}
				seen[to.ID] = true
				uses[d.ID] = append(uses[d.ID], to.ID)
			}
			defs = append(defs, d)
		}
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"defs": defs, "uses": uses, "problems": []string{}})
	fmt.Print(string(b))
}
